Message:
ALSA: hda/realtek - Enable headset mic of ASUS UX550GE with ALC295

The ASUS laptop UX550GE with ALC295 can't detect the headset microphone
until ALC295_FIXUP_ASUS_MIC_NO_PRESENCE quirk applied.
